# skycloak_cluster_upgrades (Data Source)

Version-upgrade history for a cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_upgrades" "production" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `upgrades` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--upgrades))

<a id="nestedatt--upgrades"></a>
### Nested Schema for `upgrades`

Read-Only:

- `completed_at` (String) Completion time (RFC 3339).
- `from_version` (String) Version before the upgrade.
- `id` (String) Upgrade ID.
- `phase` (String) Upgrade phase.
- `started_at` (String) Start time (RFC 3339).
- `to_version` (String) Target version.
